steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 30-second product demo of [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, 30 fps.

Before you design anything, learn the product: read [your product URL], and the codebase if you have it. Write down in one line what it does and who it is for, list its three strongest features, and show me that summary first.

Show one user doing the job [your product] exists for, on its real screens, one step per beat:
1. Study how [your product] works by using it, then pick its most impressive flow.
2. Show that flow from the first click to the result.
3. Zoom into the one detail that makes it special.
4. Pull back to the whole product in context.
End on the result they got, then the logo and [your product URL].

Look and motion: modern SaaS launch style, like the best YC launch videos: a clean canvas, the product's own accent colour, crisp kinetic type, springy UI transitions and quick zooms into the interface. A smooth virtual camera pushes into the part of the screen that matters and pulls back between steps, and a visible cursor or tap marks every action. Rebuild the screens as components you can animate rather than pasting flat screenshots.

Sound: compose a short original track in code, or use a royalty-free one and tell me where it is from. Give every cut and reveal its own sound effect, land the cuts on the beat, and mix so nothing clips.

How to build it: draw every frame in code as a pure function of time (HTML, Canvas or SVG, Remotion or HyperFrames all work), render the frames headlessly and assemble an MP4 with the audio. Then watch your render at full speed and fix anything that feels slow, cramped, generic or off-brand before you hand it over.

original.label: Prompt
original.text: Study how this https://experiments.cloudjoi.com works and use Remotion to make a product showcase video.
